verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly say Codex cloud lets you inspect the summary and diff and then open a pull request, and the CLI can run the local tools installed on your machine, which implies git use. A pre-commit/pre-PR review mode supports the review-safety angle. However, nothing documents the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, or creating branches. Missing for 10: explicit staging and commit-message generation, branch creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR workflow.
